title: PAUL TAYLOR - #FRANGLAIS - FULL SHOW
summary: Paul Taylor's first stand-up special, recorded in Paris in 2018, in which a British comedian living in France riffs on French culture, language and bureaucracy. It is the full 70-minute show.
why: Recommended as hilarious for anyone familiar with both French and British or American culture, and relevant to expats.

quote.text: I HIGHLY recommend a watch, it's hilarious especially if you're familiar with both French and British/American culture
